facts.text: The resort is in Greater Palm Springs and has a golf course.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in Greater Palm Springs, Grand Hyatt Indian Wells Resort & Villas offers world-class accommodations, luxury spa services, a golf course and outdoor recreational opportunities.

facts.text: HyTides Plunge is a three-story water park attraction with dueling waterslides, a lazy river and a splash pad.
facts.excerpt: The three-story attraction features 30-foot dueling waterslides and a 450-foot lazy river and splash pad

facts.text: The resort's pools are set against a backdrop of mountains and palm trees.
facts.excerpt: seven expansive pools with a backdrop of majestic mountains and palm trees

facts.text: The Oasis Pool is a tranquil adults-only pool with private cabanas.
facts.excerpt: the cabanas located in the Oasis Pool, our tranquil adult-only pool offer a private space

facts.text: Agua Serena Spa offers facials, massages and body treatments, a yoga studio and classes, wellness consultations and a 24-hour fitness studio.
facts.excerpt: Agua Serena Spa offers facials, massages and body treatments, a yoga studio and classes, wellness consultations and a 24-hour fitness studio.

facts.text: The resort has walking and biking trails and tennis courts.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy one of the many walking and biking trails throughout our Palm Springs resort or get in a game of tennis on our courts.

facts.text: The resort's one- and two-bedroom villas have expansive living rooms and private furnished backyards.
facts.excerpt: luxurious one-and two-bedroom villas with high-quality amenities, expansive living rooms and private furnished backyards

facts.text: The One Bedroom Villa has a living space with fireplace, a dining area with wet bar, a private patio with barbecue, and views of the mountains and golf course.
facts.excerpt: expansive residential living space with fireplace, dining area with wet bar, and private furnished patio with barbeque. Step out to stunning views of the mountains and golf course.

facts.text: The Two Bedroom Villa with Premium Outdoor Terrace has a terrace with an elevated daybed, a hot tub and a fire pit.
facts.excerpt: The outdoor terrace offers breathtaking views, an elevated daybed, a hot tub and a fire pit

facts.text: The Presidential Villa opens to golf course or lagoon views and has a private patio with an outdoor spa and barbecue.
facts.excerpt: Sliding glass doors lead to golf course or lagoon views, private furnished patio with outdoor spa and with barbeque.

facts.text: Villa stays include complimentary spa access.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary Spa Access

facts.text: Rooms have a spa-inspired marble bathroom with separate shower and tub, and a private balcony.
facts.excerpt: retreat to a spa-inspired marble bathroom with separate shower and tub. Find tranquility on a private balcony

facts.text: Ground-floor 2 King Beds with Pool Access rooms have easy pool access and an outdoor patio.
facts.excerpt: Located on the ground floor, this 550-square-foot room offers easy access to the pool along with an outdoor patio, a living area with a workspace and two king beds.

facts.text: Tia Carmen is an upscale restaurant by chef Angelo Sosa that pays homage to the Southwest's stories, land and farmers.
facts.excerpt: Tía Carmen, by renowned chef Angelo Sosa, draws inspiration from Sosa’s aunt and pays homage to the beauty of the Southwest’s stories, land and farmers through an upscale dining experience.

facts.text: Private dining in the villas ranges from BBQ packages and personal chef experiences to charcuterie boards and wine selections.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy elevated dining in the privacy of your villa, from BBQ packages and personal chef experiences to charcuterie boards, wine selections, small bites, and self-service bar options.

facts.text: The Living Desert Zoo and Gardens and the shops of El Paseo are nearby.
facts.excerpt: Visit the nearby Living Desert Zoo and Gardens, shop at The Gardens on El Paseo and El Paseo village

facts.text: Palm Springs International Airport is 12 miles away.
facts.excerpt: Palm Springs International Airport (PSP)12 miles

facts.text: Dogs are welcome, with some restrictions.
facts.excerpt: Your dogs are welcome at Grand Hyatt Indian Wells Resort and Villas. Some restrictions apply.

facts.text: A daily resort fee is applied to each room.
facts.excerpt: is applied to each room of your stay in order to provide services and amenities

facts.text: The resort was named in the Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards in 2023 and 2025.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2023, 2025

facts.text: The hotel calls itself an iconic resort with world-class accommodations.
facts.excerpt: Discover Our Iconic Indian Wells Resort, Transformed.
